tools.name: SuperStopLimit Grid V1
tools.description_en: Bidirectional buy/sell stop grid with martingale lot steps, EMA trend filter, and money-based side take-profit with breakeven lock after level 2.
tools.description_km: ក្រឡា buy/sell stop ទ្វិរផ្លូវ ជំហាន lot martingale តម្រងទិសតាម EMA និង take-profit ជាលុយក្រោយកម្រិត ២ ជាមួយ breakeven lock។
tools.requirements_en: MetaTrader 5, Algo Trading enabled, hedging or netting account. Best on XAUUSD with spread under control.
tools.requirements_km: MetaTrader 5 បើក Algo Trading គណនី hedging ឬ netting។ សមស្រប XAUUSD និង spread ទាប។
tools.how_it_works_en: Arms fixed buy stops above and sell stops below price. When one side fills, opposite pendings are removed. Exits on side USD profit, profitable lock-SL, or max basket loss, then re-arms.
tools.how_it_works_km: ដាក់ buy stop ខាងលើ sell stop ខាងក្រោម។ ម្ខាងបើកហើយលុប pending ម្ខាងផ្ទុយ។ បិទពេល side ឈ្នះជាលុយ lock-SL ឬខាតអតិបរមា រួចដាក់ក្រឡាឡើងវិញ។
tools.key_features_en:
• Fixed grid spacing in pips
• Lot multiplier per level
• One-side-only mode
• EMA trend filter
• Side USD TP & max loss cap
tools.key_features_km:
• ចន្លោះក្រឡា pips ថេរ
• គុណ lot តាមកម្រិត
• មួយម្ខាងក្នុងមួយវដ្ត
• តម្រង EMA
• TP លុយ និងដែនខាតអតិបរមា
tools.usage_notes_en: Demo first. Tune InpSideTakeProfitUSD and InpMaxBasketLossUSD to your lot size. Wider grid step = fewer fills.
tools.usage_notes_km: សាកល្បង demo ជាមុន។ កែ TP លុយ និងខាតអតិបរមាតាម lot។ ក្រឡាធំ = fill តិចជាង។
tools.proof_of_testing_en: Logic validated in Strategy Tester on XAUUSD M1; forward demo recommended before live.
tools.proof_of_testing_km: សាកល្បងក្នុង Strategy Tester XAUUSD M1 រួច demo forward មុន live។

tools.name: SuperStopLimit Hedging V1
tools.description_en: Ping-pong hedge: starts with buy and sell stops 25 pips out, doubles lot on each triggered leg until combined basket profit hits $0.50.
tools.description_km: Hedge ping-pong៖ buy/sell stop ចម្ងាយ ២៥ pips lot ចាប់ផ្តើម ០.០៥ គុណ ២ រាល់ leg រហូត basket រួមឈ្នះ $០.៥០។
tools.requirements_en: MetaTrader 5, Algo Trading, hedging account recommended for multiple legs.
tools.requirements_km: MetaTrader 5 Algo Trading គណនី hedging សមស្របសម្រាប់ leg ច្រើន។
tools.how_it_works_en: Both stops arm at 0.05 lot. Buy fills → sell stop at 2× lot. Sell fills → buy stop at 2× lot. Closes all when total open P/L ≥ target, then restarts.
tools.how_it_works_km: ដាក់ stop ទាំងពីរ lot ០.០៥។ Buy fill → sell stop ២ដង lot។ Sell fill → buy stop ២ដង lot។ បិទទាំងអស់ពេល P/L រួមឈ្នះ រួចចាប់ផ្តើមឡើងវិញ។
tools.key_features_en:
• 25 pip pending distance
• 2× lot escalation
• Combined basket TP only
• Optional max legs & max loss
tools.key_features_km:
• ចម្ងាយ pending ២៥ pips
• កើន lot ២ដង
• TP តែ basket រួម
• កំណត់ leg និងខាតអតិបរមា
tools.usage_notes_en: High risk if trend runs one way—set InpMaxHedgeLegs and InpMaxBasketLossUSD. Not per-leg TP.
tools.usage_notes_km: ហានិភ័យខ្ពស់បើទិសរត់មួយ—កំណត់ leg អតិបរមា និងខាត។ TP មិនមែនរាល់ leg។
tools.proof_of_testing_en: Backtested on demo XAUUSD; monitor basket P/L not single positions.
tools.proof_of_testing_km: Backtest demo XAUUSD តាមដាន P/L basket មិនមែន position តែមួយ។

tools.name: TrendFollow EA V1
tools.description_en: Classic trend follower: H1 EMA trend + ADX filter, pullback entry on chart TF, ATR stop, 2R target, break-even and trail.
tools.description_km: តាមទិសត្រៀម៖ EMA H1 + ADX ចូល pullback លើ chart TF SL ATR TP ២R breakeven និង trail។
tools.requirements_en: MetaTrader 5 build 3000+, any major FX or XAUUSD. One position at a time.
tools.requirements_km: MetaTrader 5 build 3000+ FX ឬ XAUUSD ប្រតិបត្តិការមួយក្នុងមួយពេល។
tools.how_it_works_en: Trades only when fast EMA > slow EMA on H1 (and ADX strong). Enters after pullback to entry EMA and reclaim candle. Manages SL/TP/trail on tick.
tools.how_it_works_km: ជួញតែ EMA លឿន > យឺត H1 (ADX ខ្លាំង)។ ចូលបន្ទាប់ pullback ទៅ EMA និងទិញ/លក់ reclaim។ គ្រប់គ្រង SL/TP/trail។
tools.key_features_en:
• HTF trend + ADX gate
• Pullback reclaim entry
• ATR & swing stops
• Break-even at 1R
• ATR trail after 1.5R
tools.key_features_km:
• ទិស HTF + ADX
• ចូល pullback reclaim
• SL ATR/swing
• BE នៅ 1R
• Trail ATR បន្ទាប់ 1.5R
tools.usage_notes_en: Use M15 chart with H1 trend default. Fewer trades in chop—ADX filter helps.
tools.usage_notes_km: Chart M15 ទិស H1 លំនាំដើម។ ជួញតិចក្នុង chop—ADX ជួយតម្រង។
tools.proof_of_testing_en: Strategy Tester on XAUUSD M15/H1 combo; optimize ADX and R multiple per symbol.
tools.proof_of_testing_km: Strategy Tester XAUUSD M15/H1 កែ ADX និង R តាម symbol។

tools.name: TrendPullback XAU V2
tools.description_en: Prop-style XAU pullback system: H4 trend, M30 entry, ADX/session/news filters, break-even at 1R, 2.5R TP, optional prop drawdown limits.
tools.description_km: ប្រព័ន្ធ pullback XAU រចនាប័ទ្ម prop៖ ទិស H4 ចូល M30 ADX/session/news BE 1R TP 2.5R ដែនខាត prop។
tools.requirements_en: MetaTrader 5, XAUUSD symbol, economic calendar for news filter, VPS for session rules.
tools.requirements_km: MetaTrader 5 XAUUSD ប្រតិទិនព័ត៌មានសម្រាប់ news VPS សម្រាប់ session។
tools.how_it_works_en: Waits for H4 EMA trend and M30 pullback to EMA with reclaim. Places SL beyond swing/ATR and TP at reward multiple. Enforces daily trade caps and prop DD rules if enabled.
tools.how_it_works_km: រង់ចាំទិស EMA H4 pullback M30 ទៅ EMA និង reclaim។ SL swing/ATR TP តាម R។ កំណត់ចំនួនជួញប្រចាំថ្ងៃ និងខាត prop។
tools.key_features_en:
• H4/M30 multi-timeframe
• ADX & session filters
• USD news block
• BE @ 1R, trail optional
• $2k prop preset inputs
tools.key_features_km:
• Multi-timeframe H4/M30
• តម្រង ADX/session
• បិទ news USD
• BE 1R trail
• កំណត់ prop $2k
tools.usage_notes_en: Set InpTradeSymbol to your broker gold suffix. Enable dashboard for prop status. Max 1 trade/day default.
tools.usage_notes_km: កំណត់ symbol មាស broker។ បើក dashboard សម្រាប់ស្ថានភាព prop។ លំនាំដើម ១ ជួញ/ថ្ងៃ។
tools.proof_of_testing_en: Tuned for $2k challenge rules; forward demo on XAUUSD M30 recommended.
tools.proof_of_testing_km: កែសម្រាប់ challenge $2k demo forward XAUUSD M30 ណែនាំ។

tools.name: SuperFiveCentBot V1.2
tools.description_en: Adaptive grid martingale for gold scalping: ATR-based step, EMA trend filter, geometric lot ladder, per-side USD basket take-profit.
tools.description_km: ក្រឡា martingale មាស scalping៖ ជំហាន ATR តម្រង EMA lot គុណ take-profit basket លុយរាល់ម្ខាង។
tools.requirements_en: MetaTrader 5, XAUUSD M1/M5 chart, low spread broker, Algo Trading on.
tools.requirements_km: MetaTrader 5 XAUUSD M1/M5 spread ទាប បើក Algo Trading។
tools.how_it_works_en: Opens L1 with trend when flat, adds grid levels as price moves against, closes each side when its basket P/L hits USD target. EMA blocks counter-trend entries.
tools.how_it_works_km: បើក L1 តាមទិសពេល flat បន្ថែមកម្រិតពេលច្រាន против បិទម្ខាងពេល P/L ឈ្នះគោលដៅ។ EMA បិទទិសផ្ទុយ។
tools.key_features_en:
• Adaptive ATR grid step
• 1.5× lot multiplier
• EMA 200 trend filter
• $5/side default TP
• On-chart dashboard
tools.key_features_km:
• ជំហានក្រឡា ATR
• គុណ lot ១.៥
• តម្រង EMA 200
• TP $៥/ម្ខាង
• Dashboard
tools.usage_notes_en: Start 0.01 lot on small accounts. Use cooldown and one-entry-per-bar on M1.
tools.usage_notes_km: ចាប់ lot ០.០១ គណនីតូច។ ប្រើ cooldown និងមួយចូល/bar M1។
tools.proof_of_testing_en: Extensive M1 XAUUSD backtests in repo variants; demo forward essential.
tools.proof_of_testing_km: Backtest M1 XAUUSD ច្រើនកំណែ demo forward ចាំបាច់។

tools.name: SuperFiveCentBot Dual Martingale V1.2
tools.description_en: Asymmetric grid: separate buy and sell lot ladders, multipliers, and max levels with total lot cap and drawdown stop.
tools.description_km: ក្រឡាមិនសមមាត្រ៖ ladder lot ទិញ/លក់ គុណ កម្រិតអតិបរមា ដែន lot សរុប និងឈប់ខាត។
tools.requirements_en: MetaTrader 5, hedging account, XAUUSD. Monitor MaxTotalLots and drawdown inputs.
tools.requirements_km: MetaTrader 5 hedging XAUUSD តាមដាន lot សរុប និងខាត។
tools.how_it_works_en: Same grid logic as v1.2 but buy side and sell side use independent InitialLot, LotMultiplier, and MaxLevels. Stops trading if drawdown or lot cap exceeded.
tools.how_it_works_km: ឡូជិកក្រឡា v1.2 តែ buy/sell មាន lot គុណ កម្រិតផ្សេងគ្នា។ ឈប់ពេលខាត ឬ lot លើសដែន។
tools.key_features_en:
• Split buy/sell martingale
• Per-side max levels
• MaxTotalLots cap
• Drawdown stop
• Adaptive grid
tools.key_features_km:
• Martingale buy/sell ដាច់
• កម្រិតអតិបរមាម្ខាង
• កំណត់ lot សរុប
• ឈប់ខាត
• ក្រឡា ATR
tools.usage_notes_en: Tune buy vs sell multipliers for biased markets. Set MaxDrawdownUSD on live accounts.
tools.usage_notes_km: កែគុណ buy/sell សម្រាប់ទីផ្សារមានទិស។ កំណត់ MaxDrawdownUSD live។
tools.proof_of_testing_en: Backtest with asymmetric settings on trending vs ranging XAUUSD periods.
tools.proof_of_testing_km: Backtest កំណត់មិនសមមាត្រ ទិស និង ranging XAUUSD។

tools.name: SuperFiveCentBot Hedge V1.2
tools.description_en: Dual-leg grid straddle from flat: can open both buy and sell L1 on hedging accounts, then martingale grid with trend filter and side USD targets.
tools.description_km: ក្រឡា straddle ពី flat៖ បើក buy/sell L1 គណនី hedging បន្ទាប់ martingale តម្រង EMA TP លុយម្ខាង។
tools.requirements_en: MetaTrader 5 hedging account strongly recommended. XAUUSD M1/M5.
tools.requirements_km: MetaTrader 5 គណនី hedging ណែនាំខ្លាំង XAUUSD M1/M5។
tools.how_it_works_en: When flat, may place both buy and sell first legs if dual-leg mode enabled. Each side grids independently toward its USD profit target with EMA filtering.
tools.how_it_works_km: ពេល flat អាចដាក់ buy/sell L1 ពីរក្នុង dual-leg។ ម្ខាងក្រឡាឯករាជ្យទៅ TP លុយ ជាមួយ EMA។
tools.key_features_en:
• Dual L1 from flat
• Hedge account design
• Grid + martingale
• EMA trend filter
• Per-side USD TP
tools.key_features_km:
• L1 ពីរពី flat
• រចនា hedging
• ក្រឡា martingale
• តម្រង EMA
• TP លុយម្ខាង
tools.usage_notes_en: Higher exposure than one-side bots—use smaller InitialLot. Not for netting-only brokers if dual-leg on.
tools.usage_notes_km: ហានិភ័យខ្ពស់ជាង bot មួយម្ខាង—lot តូច។ មិនសម netting បើ dual-leg។
tools.proof_of_testing_en: Demo hedging account tests on XAUUSD; compare vs standard v1.2 one-side flow.
tools.proof_of_testing_km: សាក hedging demo XAUUSD ប្រៀបធៀប v1.2 មួយម្ខាង។

tools.name: SuperFiveCentBot Daily Target
tools.description_en: Aggressive gold grid preset: 0.1 starting lot, 2× martingale, adaptive step, EMA filter, and configurable buy/sell USD basket profit targets.
tools.description_km: កំណត់មុខក្រឡាមាស កាច៖ lot ០.១ គុណ ២ ជំហាន ATR EMA TP basket លុយ buy/sell កំណត់បាន។
tools.requirements_en: MetaTrader 5, sufficient margin for 0.1+ grid, XAUUSD low spread.
tools.requirements_km: MetaTrader 5 margin គ្រប់គ្រាន់ lot ០.១+ XAUUSD spread ទាប។
tools.how_it_works_en: Runs SuperFiveCent aggressive grid logic: scales lots geometrically per level, closes each side at BuyTakeProfitUSD / SellTakeProfitUSD when basket profit reached.
tools.how_it_works_km: ដំណើរការក្រឡា aggressive៖ lot គុណតាមកម្រិត បិទម្ខាងពេល P/L ដល់ BuyTP/SellTP។
tools.key_features_en:
• 0.1 L1 default
• 2× lot multiplier
• Adaptive grid
• Dashboard
• Side USD targets
tools.key_features_km:
• L1 ០.១
• គុណ lot ២
• ក្រឡា ATR
• Dashboard
• គោលដៅលុយម្ខាង
tools.usage_notes_en: High risk preset—reduce InitialLot on accounts under $500. Demo mandatory.
tools.usage_notes_km: កាចខ្ពស់—បន្ថយ lot គណនី <$៥០០ demo ចាំបាច់។
tools.proof_of_testing_en: Backtest aggressive settings; verify margin survives max grid depth.
tools.proof_of_testing_km: Backtest aggressive ពិនិត្យ margin សង្រ្គោះកម្រ៉ុងក្រឡាអតិបរមា។

tools.name: SuperScalping EA V1.0
tools.description_en: Scalping grid variant of SuperFiveCent v1.1.1 logic with 0.1 initial lot, ATR adaptive step, EMA trend gate, and side USD basket exits.
tools.description_km: កំណែ scalping ក្រឡា SuperFiveCent 0.1 lot ជំហាន ATR EMA TP basket លុយម្ខាង។
tools.requirements_en: MetaTrader 5, XAUUSD M1 chart, fast execution VPS.
tools.requirements_km: MetaTrader 5 XAUUSD M1 VPS លឿន។
tools.how_it_works_en: Identical grid/martingale flow to FiveCent family: trend-filtered L1, add levels on adverse move, close side at USD target, optional trailing lock on profit.
tools.how_it_works_km: លំហូរក្រឡា martingale ដូច FiveCent៖ L1 តម្រងទិស បន្ថែមកម្រិត បិទម្ខាងពេលឈ្នះលុយ។
tools.key_features_en:
• 0.1 starting lot
• 1.5× multiplier
• Filter logging throttle
• Cooldown & one/bar entry
• Dashboard
tools.key_features_km:
• Lot ០.១
• គុណ ១.៥
• Log filter
• Cooldown/bar
• Dashboard
tools.usage_notes_en: Pair with M5 TrendTF on M1 chart. Watch spread during Asia session.
tools.usage_notes_km: ភ្ជាប់ M1 TrendTF M5 តាមដាន spread session Asia។
tools.proof_of_testing_en: Compared against SuperFiveCentBot v1.1.1 in Strategy Tester.
tools.proof_of_testing_km: ប្រៀបធៀប SuperFiveCentBot v1.1.1 Strategy Tester។

tools.name: SuperAggressive EA V1.0
tools.description_en: High-risk grid preset: 1.0 lot L1, $50/side basket TP, optional $1000 daily equity profit stop, smoothed adaptive grid.
tools.description_km: កំណត់ក្រឡាហានិភ័យខ្ពស់៖ L1 ១.០ lot TP $៥០/ម្ខាង ឈប់ឈ្នះប្រចាំថ្ងៃ $១០០០ ក្រឡា ATR។
tools.requirements_en: MetaTrader 5, large account margin, professional risk acceptance only.
tools.requirements_km: MetaTrader 5 margin ធំ ទទួលហានិភ័យខ្ពស់ប៉ុណ្ណោះ។
tools.how_it_works_en: Same grid engine as scalping family but aggressive defaults. Can halt new entries after daily equity profit target hit.
tools.how_it_works_km: ម៉ាស៊ីនក្រឡាដូចគ្រួសាតែ default កាច។ អាចឈប់ចូលបន្ទាប់ពីឈ្នះប្រចាំថ្ងៃ។
tools.key_features_en:
• 1.0 lot L1
• $50 side TP
• Daily profit stop
• Grid smooth delta
• Full dashboard
tools.key_features_km:
• L1 ១.០ lot
• TP $៥០/ម្ខាង
• ឈប់ឈ្នះថ្ងៃ
• Smooth grid
• Dashboard
tools.usage_notes_en: NOT for small accounts. Lower InitialLot before any live use.
tools.usage_notes_km: មិនសមគណនីតូច។ បន្ថយ lot មុន live។
tools.proof_of_testing_en: Stress-tested margin at max levels in tester; live use discouraged without prop-size capital.
tools.proof_of_testing_km: សាក margin កម្រិតអតិបរមា tester live ត្រូវការមូលនិធិធំ។

tools.name: SuperBot V1
tools.description_en: SuperAggressive gold grid build with extended filters: EMA spread/slope, M1 micro-trend, news, Friday shutdown, and basket USD targets.
tools.description_km: ក្រឡាមាស SuperAggressive ជាមួយតម្រង EMA slope/spread M1 micro news បិទសុក្រ និង TP លុយ។
tools.requirements_en: MetaTrader 5, XAUUSD M1, calendar data for news filter, VPS.
tools.requirements_km: MetaTrader 5 XAUUSD M1 ប្រតិទិន news VPS។
tools.how_it_works_en: Grid martingale with multi-layer trend confirmation before L1. Blocks entries near news and before market close. Closes sides at USD profit goals.
tools.how_it_works_km: Martingale ក្រឡា បញ្ជាក់ទិសច្រើនស្រទាប់មុន L1។ បិទជុំវិញ news និងបិទទីផ្សារ។ បិទម្ខាងពេលឈ្នះលុយ។
tools.key_features_en:
• 0.1 lot aggressive
• EMA fast/slow spread gate
• News & session filters
• Friday flat option
• Rich dashboard
tools.key_features_km:
• Lot ០.១
• តម្រង EMA spread
• News/session
• បិទសុក្រ
• Dashboard
tools.usage_notes_en: Press D to toggle dashboard. Tune EMA_MinSpreadPips for gold volatility.
tools.usage_notes_km: ចុច D បិទបើក dashboard។ កែ EMA_MinSpreadPips តាម volatility មាស។
tools.proof_of_testing_en: Long-form gold M1 development build; validate news filter in live calendar environment.
tools.proof_of_testing_km: កំណែអភិវឌ្ឍ M1 មាស ពិនិត្យ news filter ជាមួយប្រតិទិនពិត។

tools.name: SuperHedging EA V1.0
tools.description_en: BuyStop/SellStop recovery cycle: outer pendings at gap pips, side USD take-profit, opposite leg scaled by recovery multiplier, daily profit target.
tools.description_km: វដ្ត recovery BuyStop/SellStop៖ pending ចម្ងាយ gap TP លុយម្ខាង leg ផ្ទុយគុណ RecoveryMult គោលឈ្នះថ្ងៃ។
tools.requirements_en: MetaTrader 5 hedging account, symbol with reasonable stop level distance.
tools.requirements_km: MetaTrader 5 hedging symbol ចម្ងាយ stop level សមរម។
tools.how_it_works_en: Arms both stops when flat. Filled side works toward SideTakeProfitUSD while opposite pending scales with RecoveryMult × exposure. Resets on target or daily cap.
tools.how_it_works_km: ដាក់ stop ពីរពេល flat។ ម្ខាងទៅ TP លុយ pending ផ្ទុយ scale RecoveryMult។ Reset ពេលឈ្នះ ឬដល់ដែនថ្ងៃ។
tools.key_features_en:
• 100 pip gap default
• 2× recovery mult
• Side USD TP
• News filter
• $1000 daily target
tools.key_features_km:
• Gap ១០០ pips
• Recovery ២x
• TP លុយម្ខាង
• News
• គោលថ្ងៃ $១០០០
tools.usage_notes_en: Different from SuperStopLimit Hedging—uses side TP not combined $0.50 basket. Test RecoveryMult carefully.
tools.usage_notes_km: ខុស SuperStopLimit Hedging—TP ម្ខាងមិនមែន basket $០.៥០។ សាក RecoveryMult។
tools.proof_of_testing_en: Demo backtests on XAUUSD with varying GapPips and RecoveryMult.
tools.proof_of_testing_km: Backtest demo XAUUSD GapPips RecoveryMult ផ្សេងៗ។

tools.name: GoldMesh V4 EA
tools.description_en: Gold-focused grid martingale v2.8: gap-fill levels, EMA trend filter, trailing SL that never moves backward, dashboard, and keyboard flat close.
tools.description_km: ក្រឡា martingale មាស v2.8៖ fill gap តម្រង EMA trail SL មិនថយក្រោយ dashboard បិទទាំងអស់ពីក្តារចុច។
tools.requirements_en: MetaTrader 5, XAUUSD, hedging recommended for multi-leg grid.
tools.requirements_km: MetaTrader 5 XAUUSD hedging ណែនាំសម្រាប់ក្រឡា។
tools.how_it_works_en: Places grid levels with martingale sizing. Fills skipped levels in one tick when price jumps. Updates side TP/SL in single pass; trails profit without loosening SL.
tools.how_it_works_km: ដាក់ក្រឡា martingale។ Fill កម្រិតដែលលោតពេលច្រានខ្លាំង។ ធ្វើ TP/SL មួយរង្វង់ trail មិនថយ SL។
tools.key_features_en:
• Gap-fill up to 5 levels/tick
• EMA slope filter
• One-way trailing SL
• Sunday open hour control
• Delete key flattens
tools.key_features_km:
• Fill gap ៥កម្រិត/tick
• តម្រង slope EMA
• Trail SL មិនថយ
• បើក Sunday
• កណ្តាល់ Delete បិទ
tools.usage_notes_en: Read dashboard legend for mirror-trigger marker. Set GridStep in pips for your broker gold point size.
tools.usage_notes_km: អាន legend dashboard។ កំណត់ GridStep pips តាម point មាស broker។
tools.proof_of_testing_en: v2.8 fixes validated on gold grid gap-fill scenarios in tester.
tools.proof_of_testing_km: កែ v2.8 សាក gap-fill មាស tester។

tools.name: PropFirm 2K V1.1
tools.description_en: Prop challenge EA for $2k accounts: H4 trend, M30 pullback entries, ADX filter, news/session gates, break-even at 1R, daily loss limits.
tools.description_km: EA challenge prop $2k៖ ទិស H4 ចូល M30 ADX news/session BE 1R ដែនខាតប្រចាំថ្ងៃ។
tools.requirements_en: MetaTrader 5, XAUUSD, economic calendar, understand firm daily/max DD rules.
tools.requirements_km: MetaTrader 5 XAUUSD ប្រតិទិន យល់ពីខាតប្រចាំថ្ងៃ/អតិបរមា firm។
tools.how_it_works_en: Blocks trading when daily or total drawdown limits breached. Takes one structured pullback trade per session when filters pass. Moves SL to BE after 1R.
tools.how_it_works_km: បិទជួញពេលខាតថ្ងៃ/សរុបលើស។ យក pullback មួយពេលតម្រងរួច។ ផ្លាស់ SL BE បន្ទាប់ 1R។
tools.key_features_en:
• $100 daily / $200 max DD preset
• ADX + reclaim entry
• News & session filter
• Risk % sizing cap
• 2R default reward
tools.key_features_km:
• ខាត $១០០/ថ្ងៃ $២០០សរុប
• ADX + reclaim
• News/session
• Risk %
• Reward 2R
tools.usage_notes_en: Align InpAccountBaseline with challenge start balance. Symbol auto-fallback XAUUSD/XAUUSDm.
tools.usage_notes_km: ត្រូវ baseline គណនី challenge។ Symbol fallback XAUUSD/XAUUSDm។
tools.proof_of_testing_en: Designed for prop phase 1 pass target; forward demo under firm rules required.
tools.proof_of_testing_km: រចនាសម្រាប់ phase 1 prop demo តាមច្បាប់ firm។

tools.name: SMC Bot V1
tools.description_en: Smart Money Concepts EA: HTF structure bias, BOS/CHoCH, liquidity sweep, displacement FVG, POI entry with optional OTE and risk-based sizing.
tools.description_km: EA SMC៖ ទិសរចនាសម្ព័ន្ធ HTF BOS/CHoCH liquidity sweep FVG ចូល POI OTE កំណត់ហានិភ័យ។
tools.requirements_en: MetaTrader 5, XAUUSDm default, understand SMC concepts, demo first.
tools.requirements_km: MetaTrader 5 XAUUSDm យល់ SMC demo ជាមុន។
tools.how_it_works_en: Builds swing structure on H1, waits on M5 for sweep + MSS/CHoCH with FVG, enters on retrace to order block or FVG in OTE zone. Sizes by equity risk %.
tools.how_it_works_km: សាង structure H1 រង់ M5 sweep MSS/CHoCH FVG ចូល retrace OB/FVG ក្នុង OTE lot តាម risk %។
tools.key_features_en:
• HTF/LTF structure
• Liquidity sweep detection
• FVG & order blocks
• Optional chart objects
• Percent risk lots
tools.key_features_km:
• Structure HTF/LTF
• រក sweep
• FVG/OB
• Object chart
• Risk %
tools.usage_notes_en: Many inputs—start with defaults on XAUUSD M5 chart. Disable objects if chart is slow.
tools.usage_notes_km: Input ច្រើន—ចាប់ default XAUUSD M5។ បិទ object បើ chart យឺត។
tools.proof_of_testing_en: Mechanical SMC rules backtested; discretionary quality varies by session.
tools.proof_of_testing_km: ច្បាប់ SMC mechanical backtest គុណភាពប្រែតាម session។

tools.name: AiBot Auto Trading V1
tools.description_en: SMC context EA that sends HTF/LTF market snapshot to SEA-LION AI API for JSON trade decisions (buy/sell/skip) with WebRequest.
tools.description_km: EA SMC ផ្ញើ snapshot HTF/LTF ទៅ SEA-LION AI សម្រេច buy/sell/skip JSON តាម WebRequest។
tools.requirements_en: MetaTrader 5, allow WebRequest for api.sea-lion.ai, valid API key, stable internet/VPS.
tools.requirements_km: MetaTrader 5 អនុញ្ញាត WebRequest api.sea-lion.ai API key អ៊ីនធឺណិត/VPS។
tools.how_it_works_en: On each LTF new bar, builds SMC-style context string, calls LLM API, parses JSON for direction and levels, executes if confidence passes filters.
tools.how_it_works_km: Bar LTF ថ្មី បង្កើត context SMC ហៅ API LLM បកប្រែ JSON ប្រតិបត្តិបើ confidence ឆ្លងតម្រង។
tools.key_features_en:
• SEA-LION OpenAI-compatible API
• HTF bias + LTF entry
• JSON decision parsing
• Demo-first safety notes
• Configurable prompts
tools.key_features_km:
• API SEA-LION
• HTF/LTF
• Parse JSON
• Demo ជាមុន
• Prompt កំណត់បាន
tools.usage_notes_en: Never commit API keys. Add URL in MT5 options. LLM output is not guaranteed—use demo only initially.
tools.usage_notes_km: កុំដាក់ API key ក្នុង repo។ បន្ថែម URL MT5។ LLM មិនធានា—demo ជាមុន។
tools.proof_of_testing_en: Integration tested with API; trading edge depends on model and market regime.
tools.proof_of_testing_km: សាក integration API គុណភាពជួញអាស្រ័យ model និងទីផ្សារ។

tools.name: Supply & Demand SnD EA V1
tools.description_en: Multi-timeframe supply/demand EA: detects zones from BOS/CHoCH + FVG or pivots on M5–H4, enters on zone rejection like SnD.pine.
tools.description_km: EA S/D ច្រើន TF៖ រក zone BOS/CHoCH FVG ឬ pivot M5–H4 ចូល rejection ដូច SnD.pine។
tools.requirements_en: MetaTrader 5, any symbol with clear swings, align zone TFs with your trading style.
tools.requirements_km: MetaTrader 5 symbol swing ច្បាស់ កំណត់ TF zone តាមរបៀបជួញ។
tools.how_it_works_en: Scans selected timeframes for valid zones, marks fresh vs mitigated, waits for price rejection candle at zone edge, places trade with SL beyond zone.
tools.how_it_works_km: ស្កេន TF រក zone ថ្មី/បានប្រើ រង់ rejection នៅគែម zone ដាក់ SL ក្រៅ zone។
tools.key_features_en:
• M5/M15/H1/H4 zones
• BOS/CHoCH + FVG mode
• Rejection entry logic
• Matches Pine defaults
• MTF confluence
tools.key_features_km:
• Zone M5–H4
• BOS/CHoCH FVG
• ចូល rejection
• ដូច Pine
• MTF
tools.usage_notes_en: Pair with SupplyDemand Pine indicator for visual confirmation. Reduce enabled TFs to lower CPU.
tools.usage_notes_km: ប្រើជាមួយ indicator Pine S/D បញ្ជាក់។ បន្ថយ TF កាត់ CPU។
tools.proof_of_testing_en: Zone logic aligned to SnD.pine; backtest per symbol zone quality.
tools.proof_of_testing_km: ឡូជិក zone តាម SnD.pine backtest តាម symbol។

tools.name: Liquidity Sweep EA V1
tools.description_en: Trades liquidity sweeps only: wick through SSL/BSL then close back inside, fixed-point SL with configurable reward multiple (default 1:4).
tools.description_km: ជួញតែ liquidity sweep៖ wick ឆុង SSL/BSL បិទក្នុងវិសាត SL ចំណុចថេរ RR កំណត់បាន (លំនាំដើម 1:4)។
tools.requirements_en: MetaTrader 5, low spread scalping conditions, understand sweep vs breakout.
tools.requirements_km: MetaTrader 5 spread ទាប យល់ភាពខុស sweep/breakout។
tools.how_it_works_en: Detects swing, prior-bar, or session liquidity levels. When wick grabs liquidity and candle closes back, opens trade with SL in points and TP = SL × reward.
tools.how_it_works_km: រក liquidity swing/bar/session។ Wick ឆ្លងហើយបិទត្រឡប់ ចូល SL ចំណុច TP = SL × reward។
tools.key_features_en:
• Swing / prior bar / session liq
• Reclaim confirmation
• Fixed point SL
• 1:4 default RR
• Strict sweep rules
tools.key_features_km:
• Liquidity ច្រើនប្រភេទ
• បញ្ជាក់ reclaim
• SL ចំណុច
• RR 1:4
• ច្បាប់ sweep
tools.usage_notes_en: Tight SL needs low spread broker. Test InpLiqMode per session (London/NY best for session mode).
tools.usage_notes_km: SL តូចត្រូវការ spread ទាប។ សាក InpLiqMode តាម session។
tools.proof_of_testing_en: Sweep entries validated on M5 XAUUSD in Strategy Tester.
tools.proof_of_testing_km: ចូល sweep សាក M5 XAUUSD Strategy Tester។

tools.name: ASQ SuperTrend
tools.description_en: ATR-based SuperTrend v2 with three ATR modes, color line, signal arrows, trend duration, pip distance, strength meter, and dashboard.
tools.description_km: SuperTrend ATR v2 មាន ៣ម៉ូដ ខ្សែពណ៌ សញ្ញា រយៈពេលទិស ចម្ងាយ pips កម្លាំង និង dashboard។
tools.requirements_en: MetaTrader 5 indicator slot on chart window. No EA required.
tools.requirements_km: MetaTrader 5 indicator លើ chart មិនចាំបាច់ EA។
tools.how_it_works_en: Plots dynamic support/resistance line from ATR multiples. Flips color and arrows when trend reverses. Dashboard shows duration and distance stats.
tools.how_it_works_km: គូរខ្សែ support/resistance ពី ATR។ ប្តូរពណ៌/សញ្ញាពេលបញ្ច្រាសទិស។ Dashboard បង្ហាញរយៈពេល និងចម្ងាយ។
tools.key_features_en:
• 3 ATR calculation modes
• Bull/bear color lines
• Entry arrows
• Trend duration counter
• On-chart dashboard
tools.key_features_km:
• ATR ៣ម៉ូដ
• ខ្សែពណ៌ bull/bear
• សញ្ញាចូល
• រាប់រយៈពេលទិស
• Dashboard
tools.usage_notes_en: Combine with your EA trend filter or trade manually on arrow + line side.
tools.usage_notes_km: ប្រើជាមួយ EA ឬជួញដៃតាមសញ្ញា និងខ្សែ។
tools.proof_of_testing_en: Widely used ATR SuperTrend math; v2 dashboard tested on live charts.
tools.proof_of_testing_km: គណនា SuperTrend ATR ស្គាល់គ្នា v2 dashboard សាក chart live។

tools.name: Volume Bubble Indicator
tools.description_en: Draws volume bubbles on chart when bar volume exceeds statistical threshold (mean + N stddev over lookback window).
tools.description_km: គូរពពុះ volume ពេល volume bar លើសកម្រិតស្ថិតិ (មធ្យម + stddev លើវិន្ទ្នសារ)។
tools.requirements_en: MetaTrader 5 with tick volume or real volume data on symbol.
tools.requirements_km: MetaTrader 5 មាន tick volume ឬ real volume។
tools.how_it_works_en: Computes rolling mean and standard deviation of volume over N bars. Highlights bars with unusually high volume as sized bubbles on chart.
tools.how_it_works_km: គណនាមធ្យម/stddev volume N bar បន្លិច bar volume ខ្ពស់ជាពពុះលើ chart។
tools.key_features_en:
• Configurable lookback N
• Stddev spike detection
• Variable bubble size
• Visual volume climax
• Lightweight overlay
tools.key_features_km:
• Lookback N
• រក spike stddev
• ទំហំពពុះ
• climax volume
• Overlay ស្រាល
tools.usage_notes_en: Increase N on higher TFs to reduce noise. Use with S/D or sweep EAs to confirm participation.
tools.usage_notes_km: បង្កើន N TF ខ្ពស់កាត់ noise។ ប្រើជាមួយ EA S/D/sweep បញ្ជាក់ volume។
tools.proof_of_testing_en: Visual indicator; validate spike bubbles against known news volume spikes.
tools.proof_of_testing_km: Indicator មើលរូបភាព ប្រៀបធៀប spike ជាមួយ volume news។
